ahirika.p:
[Na + Hiri + Ka (Ka is inserted). Na hiriyati na lajjatīti ahiriko, puggalo, dhammasamūho vā. Vibhāvinī.107.]
does not feel loathing for (the loathsome Kāyaduccarita, etc.), not to be ashamed of (disgusting Kāyaduccarita etc.). Ahirika (neut.) [Ahirika+ka. (Though it should be Ahīrikka, one of 'kk' is dropped). Ahirīkassa bhāvo ahirikkaṃ, tadeva ahirikaṃ. Vibhāvinī.107.] Ahirika cetasika. The nature of not feeling loathing for (the loathsome Kāyaduccarita), the nature of not being ashamed of (disgusting Kāyaduccarita). no shame- no disgust.
